At the top is an attachment status card showing the filename "step1-jpeg.jpg" with the status text "첨부 준비 완료" on the right. Under it are upload details in Korean: "원본 7.3MB · 이 첨부의 최대 크기 2MB", "첨부 준비 파일 1.5MB · 메시지 전송 완료는 별도입니다", and a warning that compressed attachments may be lower quality than the original: "압축된 첨부파일은 원본보다 화질이 낮아질 수 있습니다. 중요한 세부 내용이 유지되는지 확인하세요." There is also a collapsible/help row labeled "이유와 처리 제한 자세히" with a small triangle/expand icon. Below that is the section label "이미지 업로드 *" and a dashed upload/drop area containing a large image preview thumbnail; the preview is a colorful gradient image with small text near the top-left of the thumbnail and a red square close/remove button with a white X in the top-right corner of the preview. Under the upload area is a required prompt field labeled "프롬프트 *" with a multiline textbox containing the text "파일 처리 중에 작성한 다음 초안". Beneath the textbox is an info icon and helper text: "어떤 표현이 거절되나요? 생성 가이드 보기", followed by smaller explanatory text: "번역 기능을 사용할 경우 보다 나은 결과를 위해 프롬프트 내용이 수정될 수 있습니다." Next is a light blue info banner stating: "V2 모델은 더 높은 품질의 비디오를 생성하며 네거티브 프롬프트를 지원하지 않습니다." The model selector section labeled "모델" shows a dropdown set to "V2 (고품질)" with a video camera icon and chevron. The resolution section labeled "해상도" shows a dropdown set to "480p (빠른 생성) 20 크레딧"; below it is a note: "V2: 480p, 720p, 1080p 지원". The aspect ratio section labeled "화면 비율" shows a dropdown set to "Auto (이미지 기반)". There is a collapsed button/accordion labeled "고급 설정" with a gear icon. A summary card below lists the chosen settings with icons: "해상도: 480p", "길이: 5 초", and "필요 크레딧: 20 크레딧". Near the bottom, a cost/status row repeats "필요 크레딧: 20 크레딧" and shows "보유 크레딧: 100,000 크레딧". At the bottom is a prominent blue primary button with a play icon labeled "비디오 생성". Layout/state: single-column mobile form view, no visible top navigation or footer, content is fully populated and appears in an active ready-to-generate state. Verdict: pass — the screen renders successfully with readable text, visible controls, and no obvious clipping, broken layout, or error state.
